mapper.sql: select setting_id, work_id, setting_type, title, content, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_novel_setting
mapper.insert: insert into ai_novel_setting (work_id, setting_type, title, content, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{workId}, #{settingType}, #{title}, #{content}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{remark})
mapper.update: update ai_novel_setting set del_flag = '2', update_time = now() where setting_id = #{settingId} and del_flag = '0'
